items.text: Jacob from Infuse Studio here, I hope everyone is having a wonderful summer! Over the last few months I have been working diligently on completely overhauling certain aspects of how our content is rendered in Spirit of the North 2. I will go into more depth on this in a press release in the coming weeks but for now, here are the patch notes!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/349b966039535816cabe071046c9fb12346d0477.jpg"]Example of new visual quality on all high settings hitting 60fps at 4k 80% render quality! Previously this was completely unattainable and I could only get about 37fps on the launch version of the game, meaning a 75.8621% fps increase on my PC with a RTX 4090. I will go into other hardware scenario's I have tested in my press release.
On Medium tier hardware can expect around a 30-40% increase over the launch version of the game on medium settings and a 13.33% over the previous version.

Lower end hardware gets huge wins with this update as I have added multiple new quality options that can be set for the game run better than ever before. Low end hardware loves the new GI OFF setting FoxTribe.
Note: these are all approximations based on my own testing with the limited amount of hardware that I have on hand. Results may vary especially depending on what settings you are trying to use.
We are now Steam Deck Verified!
Spirit of the North 2 on Steam Deck was pretty unplayable before, now players can expect a pretty solid 30fps!
Quality of Life
Minimum Spec Pop up, added a popup that will warn the user if their system specs doesn't meet the minimum requirements on PC.
Improved legibility of button icons at lower resolutions
Changed Post Processing so game looks less "washed out"
Optimizations
Full Opaque Nanite Overhaul
New "Off" option for Global Illumination
New "Very Low" options for Post Processing and Reflections
Added Ocean Quality Levels
Lumen scalability optimizations
Hair/Fur rendering optimizations
Better FPS in game menus from Fox Preview optimizations, this now includes consoles
Disabled Various plugins to save on runtime costs
Volumetric Cloud Fog is no longer active on Medium Sky Quality saving rendering cost
Rain Drop VFX improved
Steam Deck Device Profile added, now sets correct settings when first launching on steam deck targeting 30fps.
Removed Custom Depth Pass and reworked the effects that relied on it to save performance
Changed MaxScreenPercentage on Performance Quality Mode on consoles from 100% to 80%, this helps minimize memory footprint fluctuations
Changed max roughness to trace for lumen reflections to 0.2 to reduce raytracing overhead when materials are wet
Various VFX scalability added
Content Fixes
Hats no longer receive decals
Cleansed Stag VFX no longer use the geode color the player is using
Vsync option no longer visible when not in fullscreen (it doesn't work in windowed or borderless)
Water VFX no longer emissive (for real this time)
Material values overhauled on foliage like roughness and specular
Basic foliage interaction displacement added
Raven Boss (Memory) Level of detail fixes so he no longer looks like an N64 character at View Distance Quality Low
Shaman Materials reworked, not as washed out now
I wanted to give a huge shoutout to our dedicated community member Amber for helping test and verify all the changes that went into this update. I couldn't have done it without your help!
As always thank you from - Infuse Studio & Silver Lining Interactive

The melody of the north is calling once more! Today we have something incredibly exciting to share with you... so without further ado:
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png"]

We are incredibly excited to launch this update alongside the official release of the digital soundtrack on streaming music services! Since Spirit has no spoken dialogue, music is it's voice. During development, there were tracks we absolutely loved that never found a home in the main narrative. We held onto them, and wrote an entirely new story just for them <3
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/5a32fbb45c70a956b26d3ecbdf322a2cdc24f62b.jpg"]

The Lost Melodies Side Story: Embark on a brand-new questline focusing on 10 never-before-heard bonus tracks from composer Pav Gekko. Discover these hidden fragments through the quest of the Bard-Shaman!
A New Home Feature: Once you've uncovered these Lost Melodies, you can listen to them anytime by interacting with the Bard spirit right at your home base.

Unlock the Full Soundtrack: The remaining 83 tracks from the digital score can be unlocked through normal gameplay. We've also added an in-game QR code so you can easily find and stream the soundtrack outside of the game! [img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/dfb5292fc171c941380d8120288478ac70a81dae.jpg"]
New Side Story, Rune, Location, Puzzles, Cosmetics, and all-new collectibles.
New Light Essence Cosmetic rewarded at end of game's main story. If you've already finished the story simply revisit Mount Aurora to claim your reward.

Light Essence are now awarded when cleansing guardians. Whichever is associated with them. Raven -Purple, Stag-Green, etc. (Light weaver also still sells Light Essence) If you've already cleansed the guardian simply return and open the newly added chest to receive your reward.
Secret room added beneath a certain statue.
Sunken Rune no longer awarded in various places throughout Stormvale. Now is obtained in new side story.
Stacked Stone normal maps improved to retain the fidelity of the original high poly models. Lighting details on stacked stone assemblies will look much better.
Sound dampening and SFX when Submerged underwater.
Material Quality now locked on high.
Lighting and material improvements to Glacial areas.
Material fix for sliding particle and other effects that were too emissive.
Shaman Spirit now have new body types (female shamans).
Player Map updated so new additions to the landscape can be see in the render. Like the paths and landmarks for Tragedy of Veyska and other areas added post launch.
Collection tab now shows total for each sub category when selected. If you have Relics selected it'll just show total found for relics and not all collectibles.
Various scrolls modified slightly to maintain a consistent "voice" for characters. Specifically those related to the Bard characters in the update. ie Bato, Feon, and Eyma scrolls.
Rising and lower water pools now have SFX.
Loot added after finishing stag to be consistent with other guardians.
Announcement banner in Main Menu now auto scrolls.
Fox no longer creates bubbles from mouth when standing in shallow water with Runes of the Drowned.
Shaman should now show up when reviving and when returning to spot they were revived. Still Testing.
Rune carvings that glow when activated for puzzles now properly disable particle effects when deactivated.
Collision fix for rubble pile.
Wisp Form fixes. Temporal Remnant(body) no longer has emissive markings when using Wisp Form.
Hats stay on Temporal Remnant when player is in spirit form/wisp form. With exception to spirit antlers.
Photomode icons are no longer slightly squished.
Missing material fixes on a few rogue meshes.
Wisp lantern bug fix.
Lighting fix post bear guardian encounter.
Portal targets for bear encounter adjust to fix "jitter-dance" fox bug.
Stag guardian animates properly in certain cutscene.
Stag antlers particle effect no longer uses player Light Essence color.
Code added to more thoroughly Instance all static meshes in world. (Mesh Pack Plugin).
Snow WPO removed.
Fire particles that were missed now use scalability.
Misc meshes converted to nanite.
Overlapping trees in forest thinned out. Very moderately.
Removed falling rocks and breaking bridge in Dungeon. Was significantly expensive for a very small portion of the game.
Ice slide spline meshes reduce to single static mesh. To reduce hitching when they are loading.
LODs added to Red Death Trails, and other misc things.
Scalability fix for Obelisk and Home Fire.

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements for all platforms

items.text: (Live on Steam, Coming Soon to all platforms)
Be yee warned it's a long list!!
Jump-scare" bug fixed. When camera shortens instantly you no longer see the inside of the fox for a single frame.
Hats now have their own slot in the character customization tab. (No longer share slot with head runes)
Hat materials, meshes, and textures optimized.
Hat now fade with character when camera is near.
Player home portals no longer cost money to access.
Fix for Raven Groom that caused it to be strangely shiny.
Optimized many problematic textures that were taking up too much memory. -Optimized several meshes(like Grimnir corpse in cell) so they use less memory.
Optimized various SK Meshes with better LODs (things like portals, levers, guardians, etc) -Optimized Spyglass. -Added something secret... we'll never tell
Wisp fix. Many wisps didn't follow their paths as intended. They now do.
Wisp Fix. Wisp sometimes used incorrect particle color.

Massive optimization for structure assemblies in Stormvale and other parts of world. This improvement reduce the hitching that happens when new chunks of the world are streamed in when exploring. These hitches were most severe in Stormvale.
Game credit images optimized.
Loading screen polished. Shader text now matches color, fades implemented. General clean up so it isn't blip-blooping.
Grimnir Ending Encounter handling changed to make crashes less likely. (Offloads world fully before loading next level)
Desert and Cinder Fox Skins now have glowing tails like all other foxes.
Items that shouldn't ignite no longer ignite. Such as the small stone statues, turtle, and metal relics.
Items that do catch fire now ignite in the proper location and not in their center.
Splashes for breaching or submerging in ocean water now spawn at correct height.
Spirit Antlers now have near camera fade.

Optimization for Raccoon Cleaners. Raccoon Cleaners no longer spawn when items are resetting IF the player is not near the item. In these case the item resets without the raccoon appearing. Raccoon Cleaners also properly destroy/unload themselves after hiding into the ground.
Particle spawning on Grimnir now works as intended.
Bear Boss portals now teleport the player character slightly higher to avoid "dancing bug".
Water height fog turned off due to some places underground being below sea level and it was causing issues.
Fixed up lighting Post Bear Boss (it was pitch dark before).
Stag now properly animates in end encounter cutscene for Grimnir
Many other small misc optimization that are too boring to list out.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/b336259a0714d6deee119c854080d105871dbe2d.png"]
Screenshot by "G.M.S" on Steam
We have more optimizations, quality of life and overall improvements in the works for Spirit of the North 2 and maybe some additional content?!
We are dedicated to making to making the game the best it can possibly be as well as starting on some new projects in the background.
[p align="start"]Jacob Sutton (Co-Founder, Technical Director)

items.text: Engine Update from UE5.4 to UE5.6 - Giving slight performance gains and stability improvements. Over 400 changelists were submitted for this update!
Shader Precaching Added
Light Weaver now visits island for Saturday and Sunday. Location and inventory improvements.
Turtle Island Home no longer shows Locked Turtle Port locations.
Mountain Raccoon Trader #1 move to Wolf Temple. No longer sell Air Jump(only obtainable from Glacier Raccoon Trader). Level Design change to prior trader location, New perk point obtainable.
Raven Temple Lighting Overhaul.
Wisp Migration random event fixed.
Spirit Fox is no longer white for low and med material quality. This wasn't intentional.
Reset Graphics button no longer makes unintended changes to settings.
Lighting tweaks in dark dungeons in various parts of the world, mainly Ashlands.
Cutscenes and other camera switches now reset Niagara particles when finished.
Lightning VFX optimized
More chances to get cosmetic rewards in Misthaven and Mosswood.
Snow now accumulates on Fox fur!

We know optimization is a big concern for many and the majority of our focus was on improving quality settings. Graphics settings should have more predictable results and FPS is all around more stable. Beta players have reported 3-5 extra frames, and in some cases 10 extra fps. Results will vary, but we hope our efforts allow a smoother experience for many.

Today, we are introducing Hotfix #4. which brings with it a number of improvements, patches & bug fixes, details of which you can find below. But above all, this update introduces something far more important and close to our hearts: a permanent in-game memorial to Mikayla Raines.

Mikayla was the founder of SaveAFox Rescue, a passionate animal caretaker, and a gentle force for good in the lives of countless foxes, and people. We have had the opportunity to collaborate together on some upcoming news for Spirit Of The North 2, and we are fully committed to continue supporting SaveAFox in the coming months and years. We hope this memorial will be a place where you can peacefully, and respectfully remember Mikayla and her legacy.
A Place to Remember

Nestled in a quiet corner of Fox Village, you will now find a new area dedicated to Mikayla’s memory. At its centre stands a newly-implemented mural of Namara, a character from the world of Spirit of the North 2 inspired by Mikayla herself.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/c7fdb743fe62ca81281be7fc2d0de4154bd47313.jpg"]

Namara’s name means “No Sorrow” or “The One Who Dispels Sorrow.” In the game’s lore, she was a gentle caretaker of animals whose home was a flourishing garden full of life - especially foxes. Her kindness, and deep compassion made her beloved by all creatures.
You may also notice Finnegan, a small fox who hangs out near the mural, never straying far from Namara’s side. He is always there, resting by her side.

Although we never knew Mikayla personally, this is how we choose to remember her: as someone who left beauty and joy in her wake. This memorial is our small way of honouring her. We hope it brings warmth to those who knew her, followed her, or were touched by her spirit.
Thank you for sharing this world with us. And thank you, Mikayla, for helping make it kinder.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/8b53568c12ceeac13cac97e6c33f4ed82ac0fe76.jpg"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png"]
SaveAFox tribute area added to Fox Island. Featuring a memorial to Mikayla Raines.
SaveAFox logo updated in credits.
SaveAFox Finnegan NPC added to tribute area.
Sprint Toggle can now be enabled in settings. When enabled, player can sprint by toggling sprint on and off rather than by holding.

Water Rune Improvements. We felt the Water Rune was underwhelming and gave it a new fun mechanic. When rune is equipped the player character can jump while in water. Can be used for jumping across water surface or to more easily exit water. Jumping in water uses 1 spirit energy. Water rune swim speed buff decreased from x2 to x1.6. Water Geysers restore spirit energy(unchanged).
40+ Statues of Eona added through out world in an effort to reduce time spent walking back to graves.
Vixen Skin added to game with small platforming challenge.
Custom drop down menu added instead of menu anchors so scrolls boxes work properly within settings menu. In preparation to add more settings over the years.
Player character can no longer bring lit torch into Stag Guardian Encounter.
Player character can no longer carry items into final Grimnir Encounter. Will auto drop when cutscene begins.
Waypoint no longer spawns in ending level.
Various bug fixes for Palace of Peace.
Player can no longer enter Stag Temple from top to access Spirit Form rune early.

Loot Tortoise Improvements. Mushroom trails are not so far away, spawn on surfaces that can be reached, and mushrooms are evenly spaced along path to follow. Loot tortoise should now always spawn in Mushroom ring.

Base Rejuvination (Regaining spirit energy) is now paused while using Spirit Form Abilities. This change also prevent buffs to rejuvenation from exceeding Spirit Energy drain from Spirit Form. No more infinite Spirit Form when comboing Spirit Form with Rune of Suffering.
Rotation bug after closing pause menu. Fixed!
Improvements to Target Jump. Blocking volumes now more efficiently stop traces and no longer produce invalid targets.
Character friction settings are properly applied when moving from Ice to Grey Sand(Very specific I know... lets celebrate). Fixes issue where fox would continue to slide after exiting ice slides.

Spirit Form Bug Fix. When returning from spirit form to a "ragdolled" body (because of death or being struck by something) body will remain in ragdoll until recovery or respawn. Returning to dead body will no longer cause the body to play "wake-up" animation.
Spirit Form Bug Fix. Controls are no longer locked when body is "ragdolled" while player is in spirit form.
Spirit Form Bug Fix. Spirit form no longer experiences strange movement and rotation issues when body is "ragdolled".
Ram Boss melee attack range and melee trigger range are equal. Ram will no longer get stuck in endless melee attacks if player is nearby but out of damage range.
Stationary Stone Torches now properly deactivate Moon Runes when lit.
Fixed container that was missing loot. New drop location for Water Rune.
Continued environment optimization. Removed foliage hidden under static meshes.
Rebuilt HLODs.
Rebuilt Nav mesh.
Continued environment polish. Fixed various misalign geometry.
Collision fixed for particular river.
Replaced problematic cliff mesh throughout world.
Loot added to a few locations that were missing loot containers.
More environment clean up. (floating rocks, misaligned cliff mesh edges, etc)
Jump Targets block around player home mirrors.
Foxy Home doors now auto open from both sides.

Thank you for you patience and ongoing feedback. We’ve been listening closely, reading every report, and working hard behind the scenes to deliver a more stable, immersive, and beautifully optimized experience. Today, we’re rolling out Hotfix #3 the Month 1 Update - live now!
Here’s what’s included!

Backup Save System: The game now automatically creates a backup save every 25 minutes (max 10 backups). You can rollback to these if your main save is corrupted or soft-locked. Access this via Manage Save Data menu.
Save Game Naming: Simplified save file names (no special characters); Names are shorter to fix issues caused by file names becoming to long for some devices.
Save Name Auditing: Long or invalid save names are now automatically corrected to conform to new system.
Save Copy Fixes: Copying an original save multiple times during different play sessions no long causes new copies to overwrite existing copies. New save names are now unique.
Offline Achievements: Now properly tracked.

Keybinds on PC: "M" opens map, "Esc" opens Exit Menu. "Tab" still returns to your last visited tab.
Panning Map: Smoother and no longer clamped.
D-Pad Input Adjustments: D-pad up/down are no longer zooms the camera as these inputs are mapped to Fat Travel Home and Photomode. Zooming remains a PC-only feature (mouse wheel).
Pressure Plate Fixes: Now reset properly if associated objects despawn or reset, fixing several soft-lock issues.
Lava River Platforms: now spawn properly when you load game already in proximity.

Map Waypoint Fix: Waypoints now correctly place on grave icons.
Scroll Pop-up: Scroll count display fixed.
Reflection Quality Fix (Low Settings): PC visuals now look as intended. Low settings can now enjoy better visuals with no performance impact.
Adjust World Position Offset Disable Distance 100s of game actors (Hazel Bushes, various plague meshes, flags, etc). These actors would invalidate shadow cache a extreme distances.
Static mobility now applied to non-moving components (chests base, door frames, standing stones, etc.). Prevents Shadow cache invalidation.

Static mobility now applied to non-moving actors (Destructible pottery, Audio/trigger/blocking volumes, VFX, Spline paths (wisps, rivers, slides),Flag poles, hero skeletons, etc, etc). Actor that need mobility override this. Prevents Shadow cache invalidation.

We’re excited to share that Hotfix #1.3, CL 12895, now live on PC, with the console update arriving in just a few days! This patch brings a host of important fixes, quality-of-life improvements, and community-requested changes. Let’s dive in:
Collection Removed At End Of Game. Fixed issue that caused players to lose their collection(Relics and Keys) after finishing game if they died before reaching a Statue of Eona.

Save Game Repair. We implemented a script that audits and repairs your save file that runs automatically when you select a save game to play. Currently this includes fixes for those who's Relics and Keys were deleted at the end of their game. The game will re-add them when you relaunch your save game. This script also attempts to re-add your Raven companion if you have a Glide Rune but no Raven.
Landscape and Cliff meshing around Misthaven Northern gate. Waterfall and pond added to prevent players from accessing Highlands with a torch.
Jump Gate in North Misthaven now uses standing stone for activation(requires spirit form).
Stag Temple now traps player inside to force them to use Spirit Form. Many players were obtaining Spirit Form and just leaving.
Progress Lost issue #1. The Ram Encounter would continue to block autosave if the player abandoned it. This lead to player losing progress if they continued to play for a long time and then dying.

Progress Lost issues #2. Some puzzle involving hiding wisps and cutscenes would not stop blocking autosaves. This lead to player losing progress if they continued to play for a long time and then dying.
Removed rogue lever in front of Bear Guardian Temple.

Various fixes to Fox Island behavior and appearance when returning after end of game. ie Killbox under wooden bridge will not be present. Also plugged hole leading to portion of cave that is intended to be inaccessible.
Lighting changes for Lumen on Xbox Series S

Added ext triggers for some Stormvale structures.

Internet Time Events now uses our own website. This should fix the issue of events like the Light Weaver not being blocked in countries like Russia. We will continue to test and work on this and thank you for you ongoing patience.

items.text: Spirit of the North 2 is mere days away and we’re beyond excited for you to immerse yourselves in this atmospheric adventure about Fox and their Raven companion. As we near ever closer to SOTN2’s release we wanted to address the experiences many of you had with the demo that was released last year.

First off, we want to say a genuine and heartfelt thank you to everyone who shared their feedback and critiques. Not only was the feedback valid and invaluable, the sheer volume of separate Discussion threads and associated comments reiterated to us how much love you all have for our game and your anticipation for the next instalment.

While we didn’t respond to you all directly, the Infuse team did write about the SOTN 2’s demo, optimization, origins, impacts of using UE5 during its Beta phase while simultaneously developing a new game and the goals for SOTN 2 as a whole. All of which you can read here.

To continue with our goal of transparent communication we want to give you more information and context about what the team at Infuse have been working on since the SOTN 2 demo originally launched and how this work will prevent many of the challenges you experienced in the demo happening in the full game.

The last months of 2024 were spent solely on optimisation. Everything from weather, the in-game day/night cycle to UI and menu performance, has all been looked at to try and squeeze every last frame out of the game to make it as smooth an experience as possible.

There have been changes to the opening portions of the game when it comes to player onboarding. As a semi open world game with vast areas to explore, it was important to find the right balance between not showing players a dotted path in front to follow whilst also not making them feel lost with no sense of direction.

With the help of things like Red Smoke trails guiding players to all major dungeon locations (a feature call-back to the original Spirit of the North), you are able to explore the beauty and wonder of the world until your hearts content knowing that all you need to do is look for these Red Smoke Trails to instantly get back on track. This, along with other tweaks in the opening level have been designed specifically to show mini examples of SOTN 2’s gameplay loop players will experience once they are let loose into the world.

It's important to make players care about the journey they are undertaking and to care about the relationship between the fox and the raven as you help each other navigate a vast world. By far the most important way is to finalise and add in fully rendered in-engine cutscenes as well as beautifully hand drawn ones that appear during each Guardian encounter.

More recently we have done extensive compatibility testing to try and make sure we can recommend the minimum and also best suited specs for the game. As an Unreal Engine 5 title, it will need a powerful rig to see it in all its beauty but we've tried to make it as accessible as possible to players that don't have super up to date machines. There are extensive settings to tweak to your liking and even on low settings, still is a sight to behold.

We understand that everyone may not have access to the hardware required to run this game. The minimum and recommended specifications are listed on SOTN 2’s store page and we’ve also included them below. We want to ensure as much as possible that everyone can make as much of an informed decision as possible when it comes to purchasing our game.
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: 64 bit Windows 10/11
Processor: 12th Gen Intel Core i7-12700K or equivalent
Memory: 16 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 / Radeon RX 6800
DirectX: Version 12
Storage: 25 GB available space
Additional Notes: Resolution: 1920x1080 Native, FPS: 30, Graphics Setting Preset: Low
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: 64 bit Windows 10/11
Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5800X / Intel Core i7-12700K or equivalent
Memory: 16 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 / Radeon RX 7800 XT
DirectX: Version 12
Storage: 25 GB available space
Additional Notes: Resolution: 1920x1080 Native, FPS: 60, Graphics Setting Preset: High

We hope this information and context gives you some assurance to the quality of the game we’re making. Thank you so much to our community, old and new, for the level of support you’ve shown the developers, Infuse Studio and Spirit of the North 1 & 2. We’re humbled by your support.
See you in the wilderness!
Silver Lining Int and Infuse Studio
